reapack.name: GFX V4 system files
reapack.desc: GFX V4 system files (install this first: every GFX V4 plug-in needs them)

metadata.description: The shared engine and panel files (.jsfx-inc) that every GFX V4 plug-in imports. Install once.

ALIGN [phase / time align] (GFX V4). Part of GFX (Garden FX) by JGWizrad: free donationware, gardenfx.uk. Needs the GFX V4 system files package (gfx-v4-input, gfx-v4-ui, gfx-v4-panel, gfx-v4-bypass, gfx-v4-sliders). Needs REAPER 6.74 or newer.
